headline: 劳伦斯·索查递交国书并正式履任美国驻冈比亚大使
summary: 10月15日，索查向冈比亚总统阿达马·巴罗递交国书，正式开始担任第22任美国驻冈比亚大使。

sources.title: U.S. Ambassador Socha presents credentials to Barrow
sources.excerpt: U.S. Ambassador Laurence Socha today presented his Letter of Credence to President Adama Barrow at State House, formally beginning his tenure as the 22nd United States Ambassador to The Gambia.
